Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape 3:2 architectural concept illustration for an illustrated worldbook, approximately 1536 x 1024, no text.
Primary request: Make an awe-inspiring arrival at a monumental purpose-built augmented-reality megabuilding palpable. Architecture vocabulary across this concept series: an enormous purpose-built terraced rectilinear steel and light-mineral megaframe, huge stacked column-sparse world halls, dark graphite vertical lift cores, horizontal amber service bands, warm mineral floors and planted arrival terraces. It was designed from the beginning for shared embodied augmented worlds, not a retrofitted office or mixed-use shopping mall.
Scene: Low aerial three-quarter approach, high enough to grasp the entire enormous structure but low enough that a generous arriving plaza fills the foreground with recognizably human-scale people, planted islands, shaded paths and a calm arrival canopy. Diverse ordinary residents are arriving together, some carrying light wearable glasses. A very large monumental terraced rectilinear structure rises behind them across the frame, contemporary modular architecture with several giant stacked spatial volumes. Some open or glazed section edges hint at vast worlds inside without exposing every interior: huge open halls, broad physical ramps and decks, dark vertical elevator cores, and thick amber service levels. The building should clearly be a single bold architectural proposition, a new piece of civic experience infrastructure, hundreds of meters broad, not a scattering of familiar mixed-use blocks. Express the great span of each world hall and the difference between occupation volumes and servicing bands.
Composition and light: Expansive lucid daytime view with beautiful sense of scale, neutral stone, silver steel, dark cores, amber horizontal details, blue sky, foreground figures legible. Architectural editorial concept art, realistic detailed materials and atmospheric depth. Distinct composition from any earlier garden-city or community-forum images.
Constraints: No text, logos, labels, numbers, arrows, magic machinery, castle ornament, neon cyberpunk, spacecraft, generic shopping center or office retrofit. No inset diagrams or multiple panels. Concept vision, not a claim of engineering feasibility.

Primary request: A polished large architectural cutaway of an enormous purpose-built megaframe for shared embodied augmented worlds, showing the material organization that makes the experience possible. Architecture vocabulary across this concept series: an enormous purpose-built terraced rectilinear steel and light-mineral megaframe, huge stacked column-sparse world halls, dark graphite vertical lift cores, horizontal amber service bands, warm mineral floors and planted arrival terraces. It was designed from the beginning for shared embodied augmented worlds, not a retrofitted office or mixed-use shopping mall.
Representation: One beautifully composed three-quarter axonometric sectional cutaway, mostly physical engineered architecture, clearly delineated layers and spatial depth, full single-building composition, neutral quiet background. Remove the front and one side of the exterior skin to expose four very tall stacked giant open world halls, separated by distinct thick horizontal amber service bands. Each hall has real broad routes, accessible gently sloped ramps, landings, tactile handrails and modular low prop decks. Tiny inhabitants scattered on the routes give monumental scale; they are not giant cutaway dolls. At one side a dark graphite circulation core contains unmistakable elevator shafts and cabins connected to each hall with landings. Separate secondary circulation along the far edge. Thick service bands show cooling equipment and ducts, cable/network trays, compact modular props storage and robot-maintenance areas; make servicing distinct from the public world halls. Ground-level loading and robot-prop logistics are visible. A few delicate translucent pearl-blue perceptual layers hover INSIDE two world halls as suggestions of AR worlds, but at least 85 percent of the visible building remains physical section drawing rather than fantasy landscape.
Composition and style: Exceptionally legible polished architectural visualization, orthographic-leaning axonometric, crisp cut planes and soft shadows, steel and pale mineral structure, amber service bands, graphite circulation cores, subdued pearl-blue experience layers. Spatial design concept with restrained detail and rich material quality; broad empty volume in halls makes their scale clear. No repeated image composition.
Constraints: NO TEXT, letters, labels, arrows, dimensions, numbers, legends, inset diagrams or multiple panels. No generic office floors, mixed-use retrofit, castle, mall, spaceship or neon cyberpunk. No implied certification or assertion that this engineering is solved. The core subject is the purpose-built spatial and service organization.
